enabled.description: Enable or disable the sudo log server daemon.

bind_host.description: IP address or hostname the log server binds to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

bind_port.description: TCP port the log server listens on.

log_file.description: Path to the main log file where sudo events are recorded.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the log file before rotation (e.g., 10 MB = 10485760).

log_keep_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

log_compression.description: Compression algorithm for rotated logs: 'none', 'gzip', or 'lz4'.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required for encrypted connections).

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required for encrypted connections).

allowed_clients.description: List of client hostnames/IPs allowed to connect (leave empty to allow any client).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent incoming connections.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of the daemon logs: 'debug', 'info', 'warn', or 'error'.
